info.title: SEI Wealth Platform — Unified API (merged)
info.description: Auto-merged from 194 SEI SWP service specs (193 files after dropping 7 byte-identical duplicates). Each source service's component schemas are namespaced as `<Service>__<Name>` to avoid the 207 same-name/different-shape collisions across services; operation paths are prefixed with the service base-path segment (and disambiguated on collision). 7 Swagger 2.0 specs were up-converted to OpenAPI 3.0. Original path & server are preserved per-operation in `x-sei-*` extensions. Each source spec is ONE API: operations are tagged by their API (`tags`) and those API-tags are grouped into functional categories via `x-tagGroups` (Redoc), so in a viewer endpoints nest under their API. See `x-sei-category`, `x-sei-onboarding` and `x-sei-enabled` on each operation. A synthetic `GET /heartbeatapiproxy/status` health-check was added (not present in any source spec).

post.summary: An application making Investment Manager Services (IMS) API Requests from a Client/Server or Server/Server type of infrastructure will leverage the grant_type client_credentials while minting an oAuth from the Token API. The oAuth has a 60 minutes active TTL and 30 minutes inactive TTL. The OAuth obtained from client_credentials cannot be refreshed.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: The Base64 encoded form of the AppKey:AppSecret provided during application registration.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Request content type. The valid value is application/xxx-form-urlencoded.

username.description: The Siteminder service account userid that is used to mint the OAuth Token.

password.description: The Siteminder service account password that is used to mint the OAuth Token.

grant_type.description:
OAuth 2.0 grant types available depending on the characteristics of the authorization required. 
client_credentials For use for a Client/Server or Server/Server application. 
password For use for an internal, user-defined application.
refresh_token The Apigee refresh token. The OAuth obtained from client_credentials cannot be refreshed. 
sessionToken The IDP Siteminder session token.
invalidate_token

200.description: OK- The request has succeeded and the response has been returned.

400.description: Bad request - The server cannot or will not process the request due to an inaccurate request submitted by the client application.  Please resubmit the request after making the required corrections indicated in the error response.  For more Info on SEI Error Standards please refer to the API Standards FAQ under Support.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid authentication details have been provided.  Also useful to trigger an authorization pop up if the API is used from a browser.

403.description: Forbidden-The SEI Server understood the request but refuses to fulfill it.

404.description: Not Found- The requested resource or the underlying resource does not exist.  Please resubmit the request after making the required corrections

500.description: Internal Server Error - The server was unable to fulfill the request due to an unknown condition. Please contact SEI for support. For More Info please refer to the "Response & Errors" FAQ under support.

tags: Retrieve Account Details
post.summary: This API retrieves account information from SWP platform.
post.description: The API allows users to retrieve account details , account owner details, account reationship details , cash recipients information for all accounts in SWP platform associated with active entities.

200.description: Returns account details

400.description:
Bad Request - The server cannot or will not process the request due to an incorrect request submitted by the client application. Please correct and resubmit the request based on the error code and error message received among below
## List of Error Messages
| S.No | Business Exception | Status | Error Code | Error Details |
| ------- | --------| ------- | ------- | ------- |
| 1 | When invalid character is given in account number field or input length more than acceptable limit | 400 | 2196 | Account number field format is invalid or length exceeds 17 characters |
| 2 | When invalid character is given in external account identifier field with input length more than acceptable limit | 400 | 2196 | External Reference id field format is invalid or length exceeds 30 characters |
| 3 | When user Id provided is at PO/Instance level but firm id is not provided by the user | 400 | 2196 | Firm id is mandatory for PO/Instance level user |
| 4 | When account number is given in input and no unique account is available for the account number | 400 | 2196 | More than one account available in the firm for the given account number |
| 5 | When account number is not given in input and no unique account is available for the external ref ID | 400 | 2196 | More than one account available in the firm for the given external reference id |
| 6 | When account number is given in input and no account is available for the account number or the firm id is not valid | 400 | 2196 | Either the firm ID is invalid or no account available in the firm for the given account number |
| 7 | When account number is not given in input and no account is available for the external ref ID or the firm id is not valid | 400 | 2196 | Either the firm ID is invalid or no account available in the firm for the given external reference id |
| 8 | When user Id given in header is invalid | 400 | 2196 | Provided userId is either invalid or inactive |

parameters.name: AppKey

parameters.description: Portfolio group ID for which the details needs to retrieved. Any one of following is required in input (accountNumber/externalReferenceId, clientId/externalClientId, portfolioId, portfolioGroupId/portfolioGroupName).

parameters.description: Portfolio group details flag takes true/false value; if it’s true, then service will fetch the account group details and if it’s false then the service will fetch both the periodic and real time fee details. But in case of portfolio group context, this flag should be true always.

parameters.name: portfolioGroupType
parameters.description: Portfolio group type filter takes group type ID as an input like All, 258 (fee group), 188 (communication group) or 259 (investment group) type ID and based on this input, the service will fetch the respective type of group details only. If this input is not provided then service will retrieve details for all the group types in the response.

parameters.description: pageNumber field indicates the page number for which the activities needs to be retrieved.

tags: Retrieve Historic Market Value
get.summary: Retrieve historic market values at Client/account/portfolio level.
get.description: This API allows to retrieve historic market values.

parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description: This is the Consumer Key provided during the App Registration process and is used to identify the user's application.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: access_token value obtained from the Token endpoint.This is passed as "Bearer access_token"

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: The account number is an optional input. If specified, only market values related to that single account will be returned. The specified account must be an account which the input end client owns. If both accountNumber and externalReferenceId are specified, accountNumber will be used.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: The internal entity id representing a client (also referred to as party id). A client identifier is required. Conditional mandatory (Either clientId or externalClientId must be specified). If both are provided then clientId will be used.

parameters.name: externalClientId
parameters.description: The external client id associated with an end client. Conditional mandatory (Either clientId or externalClientId must be specified. If both are provided then clientId will be used.

parameters.name: externalReferenceId
parameters.description: The external reference Id of an account is an optional input. If specified, only market values related to that single account will be returned. The specified account must be an account which the input end client owns. Also, if both accountNumber and externalReferenceId are specified, accountNumber will be used.

parameters.name: firmId
parameters.description: The firm identifier

parameters.name: periodType
parameters.description:
The period for which market values should be returned. Valid inputs are:
1 – Daily (e.g. last 30 days)
2 - Weekly
3 - Monthly
4 - Quarterly
For all these frequencies Data is retrieved for maximum for last 30 occurrences or till the snapshot (data) is available, whichever is lesser.However, for the better performance/quick response of the API it is recommended that user doesn't provide more than 30 for daily and more than 12 for weekly, monthly and quarterly.

parameters.name: periodFrequency
parameters.description: The number of periods that should be returned related to periodType and startDate. For example, if periodType 1 is specified with no start date and periodFrequency was 10, the API would return values for the last 10 days from the current date. The maximum value that can be specified is 30. If no value is specified, 12 is defaulted.

parameters.name: platformUser
parameters.description: The platform user is an optional input.

parameters.name: portfolioId
parameters.description: If specified, only market values related to that single portfolio within the account will be returned. The specified portfolio must belong to an account which the input end client owns. The accountNumber or externalReferenceId associated with the portfolio must also be specified.

parameters.name: portfolioName
parameters.description: If specified, only market values related to that single portfolio within the account will be returned. The specified portfolio must belong to an account which the input end client owns. The accountNumber or externalReferenceId associated with the portfolio must also be specified.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The latest date for which to begin returning values. For example, if periodType 1 (daily) and periodFrequency 3 were specified and the start date with September 4, the API would return values for September 4, September 3 and September 2. If no date is specified, the current system date will be used. The acceptable date format is MM/dd/yyyy

parameters.name: includeIPORAccounts
parameters.description: Flag to define if the IPOR accounts market value should be included in the total market value for a Client, account or portfolio. If not specified, it is defaulted to false.

get.summary: API to retrieve the transactions for a client and account at the portfolio level.
get.description: This API allows retrieval of transactions for a client and account at portfolio level. This API supports for all account statuses and all account types.This API does not support the inactive account or client.

parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description: This is the Consumer Key provided during the App Registration process and is used to identify the user's application.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: access_token value obtained from the Token endpoint.This is passed as "Bearer access_token"

parameters.name: firmId
parameters.description: The Firm Id of an Account or Client. Firm Id is required and must be within data boundary

parameters.name: platformUser
parameters.description: Indicates platform user name

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: The identifier of the end client.This field is conditional mandatory.To view transactions at the client level either clientId or externalPartyId is mandatory. If both inputs are provided then clientId takes  precedence over externalPartyId

parameters.name: externalPartyId
parameters.description: The external party identifier of the end client.This field is conditional mandatory. To view transactions at the client level either clientId or externalPartyId is mandatory. If both inputs are provided then clientId takes precedence over externalPartyId

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: The account number for an Account.This field is conditional mandatory. To view transactions at the account level either accountNumber or externalReferenceId is mandatory. If both inputs are provided then accountNumber takes precedence over externalReferenceId

parameters.name: externalReferenceId
parameters.description: The external reference identifier for an Account.This field is conditional mandatory.To view transactions at the account level either accountNumber or externalReferenceId is mandatory. If both inputs are provided then accountNumber takes precedence over externalReferenceId

parameters.name: portfolioId
parameters.description: The portfolio id for an Account. To view transactions at the Portfolio level either portfolioId or portfolioName should be provided.To view transactions at the Portfolio level either portfolioId or portfolioName should be provided. If both the inputs are provided then portfolioId takes precedence over portfolioName

parameters.name: portfolioName
parameters.description: The portfolio name for an portfolio.This field is conditional mandatory.To view transactions at the Portfolio level either portfolioId or portfolioName should be provided. If both the inputs are provided then portfolio takes precedence over portfolioName. Both portfolioName and portfolioType should be provided as a set if any one of attributes provided

parameters.name: portfolioType
parameters.description: The portfolio type for a portfolio Both portfolioName and portfolioType should be provided as a set if any one of attributes provided. Allowed Values are 189-CAPITAL and 190-INCOME

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Indicates transaction type User can provide multiple transaction types and if not provided, then all applicable transaction types will be displayed in the response. The provided transaction type should be valid type that available on the UI Transaction Inquiry screen

parameters.name: dateType
parameters.description: The date type for the transaction. Allowed values  1 - Transaction Date 2 - Trade Date 3 - Settlement Date

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The Start Date for the transaction. Allowed format YYYY-MM-DD. Should not be future date. Start Date and End Date range must be less than or equal to 30 days.Defaults to current date if not provided

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The End Date for the transaction. Allowed format YYYY-MM-DD. Should not be future date. Start Date and End Date range must be less than or equal to 30 days.Defaults to current date if not provided

parameters.name: includeAdjustmentTransactionFlag
parameters.description: Indicates to view adjustment transactions. Defaults to false if not provided. Only True or False allowed

parameters.name: includeSuppressedTransactionFlag
parameters.description: Indicates to view suppressed transactions. Defaults to false if not provided. Only True or False allowed

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Indicates page number to view particular page transaction details. It will fetch records corresponding to pageNumber and pageSize. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Page number should be greater than  zero

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Indicates number of records to display per page  in the response. Defaults to 100 if not provided. 1-100 values only allowed

parameters.name: AppKey

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: access_token value obtained from the Token endpoint.This is passed as "Bearer access_token"

parameters.name: firmId
parameters.description: The Firm Id of library context i.e. client or account. If calling user (Proxy or Platform) is at the Instance or Processing Organization level, Firm Id is required and must be within data boundary. If user is firm level and firm Id is provided, WS will validate the same as well.

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: Conditional Mandatory, Either accountNumber or externalAccountId is mandatory. The account number for which document is being uploaded. The following account types are not supported -  House Accounts and Held Away Account. Valid Account States are Active and Settled.  Valid Account Status are WIP_Incomplete , WIP_Complete, WIP_Submitted, Pre-Open, Open and Pre-Close

parameters.name: externalAccountId
parameters.description: Conditional Mandatory, Either accountNumber or externalAccountId is mandatory. -The external account identifier for which the document is being uploaded. If both account number and external identifier number is given then external account identifier takes priority over an account number. To use externalAccountId as as input, Firm should be configured for EXTERNAL ACCOUNT IDENTIFIER service (service_id=175).

parameters.name: documentDisplayName
parameters.description: Valid Characters are A-Z, a-z, 0-9, (. , @ space - / ' & _ ) The API will trim characters exceeding 175 characters and it will display warning message.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: The Document Category Id should be an existing value in the system. The Category Id should be associated with the Folder Id. Unsupported Categories Id:  3 - Tax , 7 - Legal

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The Document folder Id for which document is being stored into. The folder Id should be an existing value in the system and it should be designated to the account or client library. Restrictions: 1. The user should have WRITE access function point to the folder and target type should be client or account. 2. The Folder Id should be associated with the Category Id. 3. Compliance folders are not supported by API.

parameters.name: classificationId
parameters.description: The classification Id should be a valid value for the Firm.

parameters.name: activityId
parameters.description: A valid Activity Id which the uploaded document will be associated to. Restrictions: 1. Activity Id should belong to the Firm. 2. Activity Id should not be locked by another user. 3. Activity Id should not be a mass transaction activity.

parameters.name: platformUser
parameters.description: SWP platform user name to designate as the creator of the record. If not specified, defaulted to Proxy ID used to call the service. Must have WRITE access to the document upload folder and have entitlement to the client or account library for which the document is being uploaded.

finalFeeDate.description: This is to specify the final fee date to be added in a package. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD) and must be a valid date. If the field is blank, then it will be defaulted to the previous date (processing date – 1).

finalFeeCollectionDate.description: This is to specify the final fee collection date to be added in a package. It must always be a valid business day after the Final Fee Date. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD). If the field is blank, then it will be defaulted to the next business day following the final fee date.

AddaFinalFeeDatetoaPeriodicFeePackage__P.description: This is to specify the list of computation portfolios (either one or multiple) which are part of the associated package in an account. If the field is left blank then it means ALL the portfolios are selected as computation portfolios. Portfolio IDs must belong to the same account and must be matching the computation portfolios of an associated package. The portfolios must be unique in the list and should be in an active status. It is a conditionally mandatory field and is only applicable if Account ID is populated.

fieldName.description:
Asset Field Name.Below are list of valid asset field names. Along with below pre defined fields, system also supports Dynamic Asset Optional Field (DAOF).User need to use exact name of the Dynamic Asset Optional Field (DAOF) in the fieldName attribute and can provide corresponding value in fieldValue attribute.
List of Asset Fields 
|S. No.|Field Name|Field Description|Possible Values/Example|Data Type|
|------|----------|------------------|---------|---------|
|1|ASSET_DESC|Attribute provides unique description of the asset under setup.|IBM|String(50)|
|2|ASSET_LONG_DESC|Attribute gives a detailed description of the asset under setup.|International Business Machine|String(200)|
|3|ISSUE_CURRENCY|Attribute specifies the currency associated with asset under setup.|USD|String(3)|
|4|ISSUE_COUNTRY|Attribute specifies the country where the asset has been issued.|US|String(2)|
|5|ISSUER_COUNTRY|Attribute specifies country of issuer for the asset under setup.|US|String(2)|
|6|ISSUER_NAME|Attribute specifies the name of the issuer of asset under setup|ABC Company|String(100)|
|7|OUTSTANDING_QTY|Attribute specifies the number of units|12500|String(100)|
|8|OUTSTANDING_QTY_DT|Attribute represents the date when outstanding quantity is captured. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or  DD-MON-YYYY|22-Aug-22|Date|
|9|DIV_AMT|Attribute specifies the amount to be paid|10|Number(17,9)|
|10|INTEREST_PAYMENT_FREQ|This attribute represents frequency of interest payment/income earned from the asset under setup. System code 36144.| Monthy|String(65)|
|11|INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION|Attribute specifies the industry under which the asset can be grouped. Table Name - INDUSTRY_HIERARCHY_LVL,INDUSTRY_HIERARCHY|Basic Materials|String(65)|
|12|RULE_144A_FLG|Attribute represents whether  rule-144A restriction is applicable for the asset under setup.|Yes,No |String(3)|
|13|IPO_FLG|Attribute specifies the availability of asset for public offering.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|14|PUTABLE_FLG|Attribute represents eligibility of the holder to force the issuer to redeem the bond before maturity.|Yes,No|String(3)|
|15|QDI_ELIGIBILITY_FLG|Attribute specifies whether the asset is eligible for Qualified Dividend Income (QDI) distribution.|Yes,No|String(3)|
|16|FATCA_ELIGIBILITY_FLG|Attribute specifies whether the asset is eligible for Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act.|Yes, No |String(3)|
|17|TRADING_STATUS|Attribute represents the current trading status of the asset under setup.|Active, Inactive, Delisted| String(30)|
|18|TRADING_STATUS_DT|Attribute represents the date on which the trading status of the asset was last updated.Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|19|SEC_13F_ELIGIBILITY_FLG|Attribute represents whether 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is applicable for asset under setup.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|20|CALLABLE_FLG|Attribute specifies whether the asset is eligible for CALL.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|21|INCOME_DIST_TYPE|Attribute represents the distribution method elected for the income from asset. System Code - 31162| Cash |String(35)|
|22|INCOME_TYPE|Attribute represents type of income from the asset.System Code - 32322|Interest, Dividend, Other_Income |String(30)|
|23|INSTRUMENT_STATUS|Attribute specifies current status of the asset under setup.|Active, Expired, Matured, Closed, Income in Default,Income and Principal in Default|String(35)|
|24|INSTRUMENT_STATUS_DT|Attribute specifies effective date from when the current status of asset is recorded. (For inactive statuses only)Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|25|PAR_AMT|Attribute specifies the amount at which an asset is issuedor can be redeemed.|0.1|Number(12,4)|
|26|PRICING_FREQ|Attribute specifies frequency at which the pricing will be done for asset under setup. |Annual,Semi-Annual,Quaterly,Bi-Monthly,Monthly,Bi-Weekly,Weekly,Daily,Every Business Day,Every Week Day,3x a yr,Irreg,Interest at Maturity,Payable at Maturity|String(65)|
|27|PRICING_METHOD|Attribute specifies method of pricing the asset under setup.|Vendor Priced,Periodic Manual Price,Static Manual Price,Matrix Pricing,None|String(35)|
|28|RISK_CAT|Attribute specifies the category of risk|Country,Region|String(35)|
|29|RISK_COUNTRY|Attribute specifies the country ofrisk.|US|String(2)|
|30|REGION_OF_RISK|Attribute specifies the region ofrisk.|US|String(65)|
|31|SINKABLE_FLG|Attribute represents a sinkable schedule.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|32|SMALLEST_DENOMINATION|Attribute represents the smallestpermissible denomination at which the asset can be traded. |0.1|Number(17,4)|
|33|VIEWING_ASSET_TYPE|Attribute represents Firm configured Asset Classification. Data should be entered in following format and description should match exactly as defined in the hierarchy.|Level1>Level2>Level3>Level4 |String(65)|
|34|BUY_SETTLE_DAY_COUNT|Attribute represents the number of days between trade and settlement date for purchases|1|Number(2)|
|35|SELL_SETTLE_DAY_COUNT|Attribute represents the number of days between trade date and settlement date for  redemptions |1| Number(2)|
|36|REGISTRAR_COUNTRY|Attribute represents the country of institution which keeps the records of assets.|US|String(2)|
|37|FOREIGN_OWNERSHIP_IND|Attribute represents foreign ownership eligibility of the asset under setup.|Foreign owners restricted,Partial foreign ownership acceptable,Foreign owners acceptable|String(40)|
|38|FORM|Attribute represents the type of financial agreement between  buyer and seller.|Registered,Coupon or Bearer, Registered and Coupon,No Information Available |String(35)|
|39|INCOME_CURRENCY|Attribute specifies the currency in which income from the asset would be disbursed.|USD|String(3)|
|40|PLACE_OF_LISTING|Attribute represents whether the asset under setup is eligible for listing.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|41|POTAM_IND|Attribute represents whether the Panel of Takeovers and Mergers is applicable or not.|Not Applicable,UK Panel Only,Irish Panel Only,UK and Irish Panel,UK and International Panel,Irish and International Panel|String(35)|
|42|SMALLEST_TRADE_INCREMENT|Attribute represents the permissible smallest increment over and above smallest trade quantity of asset that can be traded.|0.1|Number(17,4)|
|43|SMALLEST_TRADE_QTY|Attribute specifies the smallest quantity of asset that can be traded.|0.1|Number(17,4)|
|44|ASSET_RISK_RATING|Attribute represents the risk rating for the asset under setup. |Low Risk|String(65)|
|45|INVESTMENT_GRADE|Attribute represents the quality of a company/organization's credit. Table Name -INVESTMENT_GRADE |Investment Grade|String(65)|
|46|EX_DIV_DT|Attribute represents the date. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|47|5498_SPECIFIED_ASSET_FMV_CD|Attribute represents the asset specific codes specified by the IRS on form 5498 for valuation of asset.|Stock or own interest in corp. not readily tradable on est. mkt,Short or long-term debt obligation not traded on est. mkt,Own FMV|String(65)|
|48|DUAL_STATE_EXEMPT_ID|Attribute represents if dual tax is exempted for income in multiple states in the US|DE, NJ (Port Authority),NJ, PA (Port Authority),VA, DC (Port Authority),NY, NJ (Port Authority),MD, DC, VA (Metro Area Transit Bond),No State|String(65)|
|49|FED_OR_STATE_TAX_INCOME_TYPE_ID|Attribute represents whether the income is subject to federal tax|Taxable Federal only,Taxable State only,Taxable Federal and State (both taxable),Non-Taxable Federal and State (both non-taxable)|String(65)|
|50|INCOME_SUB_TO_AMT_FLG|Attribute states whether the income from asset is subject to Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT)|Yes, No|String(3)|
|51|INCOME_SUB_TO_WHT_FLG|Attribute specifies whether the income fromthe asset would be subject to tax withholding.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|52|INCOME_TREATMENT_CD|Attribute specifies the treatment code for classifying the income from asset under setup.|Other Income|String(65)|
|53|TAX_ELIGIBILITY|Attribute represents if the asset is eligible for the tax or to be exempted.|Liable,Conditionally Exempt,Under Review,Unconditionally Exempt,Partially Exempt,Not Applicable|String(65)|
|54|COUPON_RT|Attribute specifies the coupon rate used for calculating interest on the asset under setup.|0.3|Number(17,9)|
|55|DAY_COUNT_BASIS|Attribute specifies the interest accrual calculation over a period of time.|Actual / 360,30 / 360,Actual /Actual ISMA,Actual / 365,30 / 365,Actual / Actual ISDA,30E / 360,30E+ / 360,30_360 SIA,BUS_252,30_60 GERMAN,Actual_365 ISDA|String(65)|
|56|RECURRENCE_DESC|Attribute represents the description of frequency for payment related to the asset under setup.|Free Text|String(1000)|
|57|BUY_CASH_SETTLE_DAY_COUNT|Attribute specifies the override Settlement Day Count for Security Buy|1|Number(2)  |
|58|SELL_CASH_SETTLE_DAY_COUNT|Attribute specifies the override Settlement Day Count for Security Sell|1|Number(2)  |
|59|BOND_DEFAULT_DT|Attribute represents the date post which the issuer is defaulted for income disbursement. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|60|DATED_DT|Attribute represents the date from which interest begins to accrue for the asset. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY|22-Aug-22|Date|
|61|END_OF_MONTH_FLG|Attribute specifies whether end of month to be applied or not.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|62|MATURITY_EXP_DT|Attribute represents the date on which principal amount of the asset becomes due for payment to the investor. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|63|FINAL_PAYMENT_BEFORE_MATURITY|Attribute represents the date when a final payment will be issued before maturity. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|64|INTEREST_AT_MATURITY_FLG|Attribute represents whether interest is paid on maturity for the asset under setup.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|65|FIRST_PAYMENT_DT|Attribute represents the first payment due date.Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|66|FIRST_SETTLEMENT_DT|Attribute represents the first payment settlement date. Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY|22-Aug-22|Date|
|67|ISSUE_DT|Attribute represents the date on which the asset is/was issued.Supported Format DD-MON-YY or DD-MON-YYYY |22-Aug-22|Date|
|68|ISSUE_PRICE|Attribute specifies the opening/launch price of the asset under setup.|ISO Currency Code|String(3)|
|69|LAST_DAY_INCLUSION_FLG|Attribute specifies whether the last payment date is included in the accrual period or not.|Yes,No|String(3)|
|70|ODD_COUPON_IND|Attribute represents when the first or last coupon payment period is longer or shorter than normal.|First - Regular LastRegular,First - Regular Short Last,First - Regular Long Last,Short First Last Regular,Short First Short Last,Short First Long Last,Long First Last - Regular,Long First Short Last,Long First Long Last,Not Available|String(65)|
|71|PERPETUAL_REDEMPTION_FLG|Attribute indicates whether the asset has perpetual redemption. Represents that the asset has no maturity date and interest is paid on it forever|Yes, No|String(3)|
|72|PRINCIPAL_GUARANTEED_FLG|Attribute represents whether the vested amount repayment agreement is applicable or not.|Yes, No|String(3)|
|73|REDEMPTION_VALUE|Attribute specifies the sell-out value of the asset at a given point of time.|0.1|Number(18,9)   |
|74|SAA_RT_TYPE_IND|Attribute represents the type of rate associated with the Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) portfolio strategy|Fixed, ariable|String(30)|

firmId.description: The Firm Id where capital commitment needs to be maintained. Firm Id is required and must be within data boundary.

poId.description: The processing Org Id where capital commitment needs to be maintained.

universalLevelId.description: The universal Level Id where capital commitment needs to be maintained.

capitalCommitmentId.description: Internal SWP Id on the platform to uniquely identify the commitment record. If Action is Create and capitalCommitmentId is specified, capitalCommitmentId will be ignored for processing. If Action is Modify and capitalCommitmentId is specified, then any value provided in accountId, accountNumber, portfolioId, portfolio Name, instrumentId, assetIdentifierType, assetIdentifierValue, assetCountryOfMarket and assetExchange will be ignored for processing. If Action is Delete and capitalCommitmentId is specified, then all other information will be ignored for processing.

action.description: Identifies if the API request is for Create, Modify or Delete and the attribute is case insensitive purpose.

accountId.description: Internal SWP Id to uniquely identify an account. If accountId is not specified, then accountNumber must be specified. If accountId is specified, then accountNumber will be ignored for processing, even if specified.

accountNumber.description: This is the SWP Account Number for which the commitment record has to be maintained. If accountNumber is not specified, then accountId must be specified. If accountId is specified, then accountNumber will be ignored for processing, even if specified.

portfolioId.description: Internal SWP Id to uniquely identify the portfolio of the account for which commitment maintanence needs to be performed. If portfolioId is not specified, then portfolioLongName must be specified. If portfolioId is specified, then portfolioLongName will be ignored for processing, even if specified.

portfolioLongName.description: Long description of the Portfolio Name of the Account for which commitment maintanence needs to be performed. If portfolioLongName is not specified, then portfolioId must be specified. If portfolioId is specified, then portfolioLongName will be ignored for processing, even if specified.

instrumentId.description: This is the SWP trading level instrument id for the capitalized alternative. If INSTRUMENT_ID is specified, then other Asset details will be ignored for futher processing, even if specified. For Actions Modify and Delete, if capitalCommitmentId is specified, then ignore all instrument related attributes for further processing.

assetIdentifierType.description: This is the asset identifier type of the asset for which the Capitalized Asset Transaction record is loaded. A unqiue asset must be derived with the combnation of Type, Value, Country of Market and Exchange combination, whichever is present. If INSTRUMENT_ID is specified, then other Asset details will be ignored for futher processing. For Actions Modify and Delete, if capitalCommitmentId is specified, then ignore all instrument related attributes for further processing.

assetIdentifierValue.description: This is the asset identifier value corresponding to the asset identifier type for which the Capitalized Asset Transaction record is loader. A unqiue asset must be derived with the combnation of Type, Value, Country of Market and Exchange combination, whichever is present. If INSTRUMENT_ID is specified, then other Asset details will be ignored for futher processing. For Actions Modify and Delete, if capitalCommitmentId is specified, then ignore all instrument related attributes for further processing.

assetCountryOfMarket.description: This is the country of market of the asset. If a unique asset is not derived based on asset identifer type and value then country of market can be provided. A unqiue asset must be derived with the combnation of Type, Value, Country of Market and Exchange combination, whichever is present. If INSTRUMENT_ID is specified, then other Asset details will be ignored for futher processing. For Actions Modify and Delete, if capitalCommitmentId is specified, then ignore all instrument related attributes for further processing.

assetExchange.description: This is the market exchange of the asset. If a unique asset is not derived based on asset identifer type, value and country of market, then asset exchange can be provided. A unqiue asset must be derived with the combnation of Type, Value, Country of Market and Exchange combination, whichever is present. If INSTRUMENT_ID is specified, then other Asset details will be ignored for futher processing. For Actions Modify and Delete, if capitalCommitmentId is specified, then ignore all instrument related attributes for further processing.

ownershipPercentage.description: Ownership percentage of the Client's Portfolio. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

originalCommitmentAmount.description: This is the Amount of the Original Commitment. This will be mandatory if the action is Create. Entered amount must satisfy the currency rounding rules. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

contributedCapitalAmount.description: This is the Amount of the Contributed Commitment. Entered amount must satisfy the currency rounding rules. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

commitmentTillDateAmount.description: This is the Amount of the  Commitment till date amount. Entered amount must satisfy the currency rounding rules. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

commitmentStartDate.description: This is the Start Date of the Commitment. For Action Create - This should be present if End Date of the Commitment has been specified. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

commitmentEndDate.description: This is the End Date of the Commitment. For Action Modify - Atleast one of Ownership Percentage, Original Commitment Amount, Contributed Capital Amount, Commitment Till Date Amount, Commitment Start Date or Commitment End Date should be present.

loaderActivityId.description: This is to capture the Loader Activity Id for the Transaction

submissionActivityId.description: This is to capture the Loader Submission Activity Id for the Transaction

loaderRecordCount.description: This is to capture the corresponding Loader Record Count for the Transaction

settlementDate.description: The date when the executed deal is likely to settle. The Cash Settlement Date field cannot be less than the Trade Date. Format should be YYYY-MM-DD

accountNumber.description: Account Number for which the trade details are being captured in SWP. Account Number is the externally-known identifier for an account.

portfolioName.description: Name of the Portfolio under which the buy trade needs to be captured. Its the basic name that most frequently used for display and reporting purposes.

interestReceived.description: Interest Received for Capitalized Asset Transaction

costToAdjust.description: Cost to Adjust for Capitalized Asset Transaction

TransactionDescriptionAddendum.description: This attribute can be used by the API clients to provide a text that would be appended to the transaction description.

transactionSupressionInd.description: This specifies whether the transaction needs to be suppressed or not. Allowed values are 1 for No, 2 for Statements, 3 for Statements and Contract Notes/Advices, 4 for Contract Notes/Advices.

rebookingIndicator.description: This states whether trade is a rebooking trade or not. Default value is false.

reasonCode.description: This attribute can be used by the API clients to provide a reason code for the trade. Reason Code must be applicable for the transaction type. Reason Code must be specified if Reason Comment is specified in the request.

reasonComment.description: This attribute can be used by the API clients to provide a reason comment for the trade. Reason Code must be specified if Reason Comment is specified in the request.

notestoClient.description: Clarifying textual information related to the executed Deal.

CashTransfers__Withholdings.description:
Configuration to override default withholding details for an account. These inputs are optional, if they are not provided as inputs for qualified accounts, then the withholdings will be defaulted based on the configuration that is in place. A qualified transfer is a cash disbursement from an IRA account (or the disbursement leg of a cash transfer) with a specific treatment code determined by configuration. For a given Account Type, Transaction Type, Treatment Code, Tax type and Tax Authority, the withholdingss are only applied if the Calculated Gross Amount for WH > Minimum Gross Amount (Calculated Gross Amount varies based on the amount spec type and presence of fees). </br>
If both amount and percentage are provided to be overridden, then amount takes precedence.

waiveFederalWithholding.description: Indicator to waive federal withholding for IRA transfers

waiveStateWithholding.description: Indicator to waive state withholding for IRA transfers

overrideFederalWithholdingAmount.description: Amount for federal withholding if overriding the default Federal Withholding amount. Length - 17,3

overrideStateWithholdingAmount.description: Amount for state withholding if overriding the default State Withholding amount. Length - 17,3

overrideFederalWithholdingPercentage.description: Percentage for federal withholding if overriding the default Federal Withholding percentage. Length - 9,5

overrideStateWithholdingPercentage.description:
Percentage for state withholding if overriding the default State Withholding percentage. =>

* If calculation type is percentage of gross (1), regardless of amount type, aggregate (fedWh + stateWH) percentage should not be more than or equal to 100.

* If calculation type is percentage of federal (2), regardless of amount type, Fed withholding percentage should not be greater than or equal to 100%. 
* Length - 9,5

CurrencyDisbursements__WithholdingDetail.description:
Configuration to override default withholding details for an account. These inputs are optional, if they are not provided as inputs for qualified accounts, then the withholdings will be defaulted based on the configuration that is in place just as it is today. A qualified distribution is a cash disbursement from an IRA account (or the disbursement leg of a cash transfer) with a specific treatment code determined by configuration. For a given Account Type, Transaction Type, Treatment Code, Tax type and Tax Authority, the withholdingss are only applied if the Calculated Gross Amount for WH > Minimum Gross Amount (Calculated Gross Amount varies based on the amount spec type and presence of fees). </br>
If both amount and percentage are provided to be overridden, then amount takes precedence.

waiveFederalWithholding.description: Indicator to waive federal withholding for IRA disbursements, having possible values of true or false. If this waiveFederalWithholding flag value is not provided system will consider the default configuration for federal withholding.

waiveStateWithholding.description: Indicator to waive state withholding for IRA disbursements, having possible values of true or false. If this waiveStateWithholding flag value is not provided system will consider the default configuration for state withholding.

overrideFederalWithholdingAmount.description: Amount for federal withholding if overriding the default Federal Withholding amount. Length - 17,3

overrideStateWithholdingAmount.description: Amount for state withholding if overriding the default State Withholding amount. Length - 17,3

overrideFederalWithholdingPercentage.description: Percentage for federal withholding if overriding the default Federal Withholding percentage. Length - 9,5

overrideStateWithholdingPercentage.description:
Percentage for state withholding if overriding the default State Withholding percentage. =>

* If calculation type is percentage of gross (1), regardless of amount type, aggregate (fedWh + stateWH) percentage should not be more than or equal to 100.

* If calculation type is percentage of federal (2), regardless of amount type, Fed withholding percentage should not be greater than or equal to 100%. 
* Length - 9,5

taxWithholding1099r.description: Flag to determine if the Cash Distribution will be considered for 100% Withholding for either state or federal. If true, all other withholding fields will be ignored.

CurrencyDisbursements__PayToDetails.description:
Either payToProfileId or adhocPayToDetails has to be provided. Both inputs cannot be provided at the same time. 
At the P.O. or Firm level, for the"Pay To" party, the address is optional if the following conditions are met. Otherwise, an address is required. When the Profile ID is provided, then the address from the profile is used for validation.1) Anti-Money Laundering (Service 134 - "Disable AML Jobs for the Instance") turned on. 2) Customer Identification Program (Service 44 - "Patriot Act Compliance") is turned off. 3)"FIRM_PROFILE_MATRIX" table is configured so that the address is not required for the party.For "Pay To" Recipients an election of whether an address is required or not by Transaction Type (Cash Disbursement) and Payment Method must be configured. For Check Disbursements Check Delivery Method must be configured to indicate whether an address is required or not on the check.
       Optional/Mandatory =>

       * One Time Ad hoc -  Optional
       * One Time Scheduled -  Optional
       * Recurring -  Optional
       * Memo Post  -  Optional

payToProfileId.description:
The Profile Id of an existing Pay-To recipient associated with the account and designated payment method. Future and recurring disbursements can only be sent to a pre-established recipient.The Entity person or organization and the associated Financial Institutions and Intermediaries associated with this Pay To Profile ID are subject to AML Review for Firms subject to SPTC AML monitoring.Failure to pass AML Review results in the request going into Exception "Under Review". Once SPTC reviews the Pay To they may pass the review which allows the cash movement to be marked Complete or they may fail the review and the cash movement must eb cancelled Only Pay To Profile IDs which entities and Financial institutions have passed AML review can be used. Adhoc Pay To Information One-time (adhoc) Pay To can only be used for one-time adhoc disbursement.The Pay To type information provided must match the cash disbursement method type (e.g. If Check method is selected" Check ‘Pay To’ details must be provided).

firmId.description: Identifies the Firm ID associated with the firm for which the fee package needs to be added to the account.

platformUser.description: SWP platform user name to designate as the creator of the record. Based on the input request, the user must have required function points i.e. 225 – Account Fees, 4866 – Non-firm fee packages. Must have data entitlement to the account and package.

accountId.description: Account ID for which the fee package needs to be associated.

feePackageProfileId.description: Periodic fee package ID that needs to be assigned.

advanceArrearsFlag.description: Arrear/Advance Flag value that needs to be assigned to respective fee package association. Valid possible values are <Blank> ie.'' or '1' or '2'. In case of <Blank> value in input, service will populate this value based on defaulting logic for fee package assignment as 'Advance' or 'Arrears'.

firstFeeFlag.description: The indicator to determine if the First Fee field in the fee package assignment should be selected. If 1 (Yes), the fee period begins from the date provided in the startDateForFee field. If 2 (No), the fee period begins from the start of the computation period, regardless of the startDateForFee field value. If no value is provided, the default value is 1 (Yes).

fundingSetsStartDateFlag.description: The indicator to determine the value for the Account Funding Sets the Start Date for Fee field in the fee package assignment. If 1 (Yes), the Start Date for Fee will be determined by the account’s funding date. If 2 (No), the Start Date for Fee is not dependent on the account’s funding date. The field is not allowed to be valued when the firm is not configured for this functionality. When the account is already funded, this field can only be valued as 2 (No). If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration and account setup - If the firm is not using this functionality, set as 2. If the firm is using the functionality and the account is not funded, set as 1. If the firm is using the functionality and the account is funded, set as 2.

startDateForFee.description: The Start Date For Fee field in the fee package assignment. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration, account setup and other parameters’ values. In an ideal case, the start date will be set to the processing date. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD), must be a valid date and must not be prior to the account’s opening date, more than 2 years in the past or after the next computation date.

frequency.description: The Computation Interval Frequency field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are either 1 (Monthly), 3 (Quarterly), 6 (Semi Annually) or 12 (Annually), based on the system code ID 33285. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configured value.

exCashNCashEquiFlag.description: The Exclude Cash and Cash Equivalents in Non-Strategy Portfolios field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are either 1 (Yes) or 2 (No). This field is only allowed to be valued when the firm is configured for this functionality. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configured value.

feeBasisLevel.description: The Fee Basis Level field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are either 1 (Household), 2 (Account) or 3 (Client). This field is only allowed to be valued when the firm is configured for this functionality. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configured value.

nextComputationDate.description: The Next Computation Date field in the fee package assignment. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration and account setup and other parameters’ values. The field is not allowed to be valued if the Start Date for Fee or Frequency fields are not provided. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD) and must be a valid date. The day portion must match what is selected as the Fee Year End Day on the Fee Profile and the month portion must be aligned with the selected Computation Interval Frequency. It cannot be prior to the Start Date For Fee. It cannot be more than one Computation Interval Frequency in the future from the Start Date For Fee unless the First Fee indicator is selected.

annualFeePackageMinimumAmount.description: The Annual Fee Package Minimum field in the fee package assignment. Values can have up to ten digits total, including up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999. If providing both an Annual Fee Package Minimum and an Annual Fee Package Maximum, the minimum value must be lower than the maximum value. If a value is not provided, then no fee package minimum amount will be set up for the record. The field is not allowed to be valued when the firm is not configured for this functionality.

annualFeePackageMaximumAmount.description: The Annual Fee Package Maximum field in the fee package assignment. Values can have up to ten digits total, including up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999. If providing both an Annual Fee Package Minimum and an Annual Fee Package Maximum, the maximum value must be greater than the minimum value. If a value is not provided, then no fee package maximum amount will be set up for the record. The field is not allowed to be valued when the firm is not configured for this functionality.

processingLagDays.description: The Processing Lag field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are whole numbers between 0 and 99. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration or configuration for the fee type(s) in the fee package.

collectionDay.description: The day portion of the Collection Interval On field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are whole numbers between 1 and 28 or 32. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration or configuration for the fee type(s) in the fee package. The field is not allowed to be valued if the Collection Month field is not provided and is mandatory if the Collection Month field is provided.

collectionMonth.description: The month portion of the Collection Interval On field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are whole numbers between 1 and 12. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the firm’s configuration. The field is not allowed to be valued if the Collection Day field is not provided and is mandatory if the Collection Day field is provided.

collectionMethod.description: The Periodic Fee Collection Method field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are either 1 (Direct Charge), 2 (Do Not Charge), 3 (Collect From Another Account) or 5 (Invoice), based on the system code ID 33302. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted to 1 (Direct Charge). This is an optional field in most cases, however it is a required field for PAS (Portfolio Aggregation Services) accounts. The collection method cannot be 5 (Invoice) if the firm is not configured for invoicing functionality.

additionalCollectionAccountFlag.description: The Additional Collection Account field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are either 1 (Yes) or 2 (No). If a value of 1 (Yes) is provided, then the Periodic Fee Collection Method must be either 1 (Direct Charge) or 3 (Collect From Another Account). If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted to 2 (No). The field is not allowed to be valued if the firm and fee types in the fee package are not configured for this functionality.

anotherCollectionAccountId.description: The Collection Account ID field that appears in the fee package assignment when the collection method is selected as Collect From Another Account. This field value cannot be the same as the Account ID and must be an active account within the same firm. The field is mandatory if the collection method is 3 (Collect From Another Account) and is not allowed to be valued for any other collection method value.

firmContact.description: The Firm Contact field in the fee package assignment. Valid values are Employee Tag Type IDs for the given account and firm. The field is mandatory if the collection method is 5 (Invoice) and the firm is configured for this functionality and it is not allowed to be valued for any other collection method value or when the firm is not configured for this functionality.

finalFeeDate.description: The Final Fee Computation Date field in the fee package assignment. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD), must be a valid date and must not be prior to the Start Date For Fee.

finalFeeCollectionDate.description: The Final Fee Collection Date field in the fee package assignment. Values provided must be in the proper date format (YYYY-MM-DD), must be a valid date and must be a valid business day after the Final Fee Date. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted to the next business day following the Final Fee Date. The field is not allowed to be valued when Final Fee Date is not provided.

DetailedPeriodicFeePackageAssignmentfora.description: The Net Portfolios For Fee field in the fee package assignment, specifying the list of computation portfolios which need to be part of the package association. If the field is left blank then ALL of the portfolios are selected as computation portfolios or a user can specify a single or multiple portfolios. Portfolio IDs must be in an active status, must belong to the same account and must be unique in the list.

The Portfolio To Charge table in the fee package assignment. This is an optional list. If populated, then all of the fields in the list must be provided. If the collection needs to be split across multiple portfolios, the list needs to be repeated for each collection portfolio. The list is not allowed to be valued if the collection method is selected as 5 (Invoice). If the list is not provided, the oldest capital portfolio is chosen as the single collection portfolio for accounts not in the Advisor Market. For more information about the collection portfolio derivation logic for the Advisor Market, see Appendix B in the user guide. When the Additional Collection Account Flag is 1 (Yes), the configured default house account details will be used for the percentage allocation between the client account and the house account. The list contains the following 3 fields Collection Portfolio ID, Portfolio Allocation Percentage, House Account Flag.

collectionPortfolioId.description: The collection portfolio in the fee package assignment. It is a conditionally mandatory field in that it is only required when Portfolio Allocation Percentage is provided. This field value cannot be duplicated within the Collection Portfolio To Charge List and must be an active portfolio ID belonging to the appropriate account, according to this logic 1)  If Collection Method is 2 (Do Not Charge) or Collection Method is 1 (Direct Charge) and House Account Flag is 2 (No), then the portfolio must belong to the account in the record. 2) If House Account Flag is 1 (Yes), then the portfolio must belong to a Firm House Account in the same firm. 3) If Collection Method is 3 (Collect From Another Account) and House Account Flag is 2 (No), then the portfolio must belong to the Another Collection Account ID in the record. 4) If Collection Method is 3 (Collect From Another Account) and House Account Flag is 1 (Yes), then the portfolio cannot belong to the Another Collection Account ID in the record. If a value is not provided, then it will be defaulted based on the PO/firm’s configuration (oldest capital portfolio for accounts not in the Advisor Market; see Appendix B in the user guide for more information about the collection portfolio derivation logic for the Advisor Market).

portfolioAllocationPercentage.description: The Portfolio Allocation (%) field in the fee package assignment. It is a conditionally mandatory field in that it is only required when Collection Portfolio ID is provided. Valid values are whole numbers between 1 and 100. Across all of the collection portfolios provided in the Collection Portfolio To Charge List, the Portfolio Allocation Percentage must sum to 100.

houseAccountFlag.description: This identifies whether or not the collection portfolio belongs to a Firm House Account. Valid values are either 1 (Yes) or 2 (No). If Additional Collection Account Flag is 1 (Yes), then this must be 1 (Yes) for only one collection portfolio; across all of the collection portfolios in the Collection Portfolio To Charge List, only one collection portfolio can have the House Account Flag as 1 (Yes). If Additional Collection Account Flag is 2 (No), then this must be 2 (No) for all collection portfolios in the Collection Portfolio To Charge List.

sellAmount.description: The amount that would be sold as a result of capturing the executed fx deal.

It is mandatory for final close with net settlement = Yes.

gainLossAmount.description: Gain Loss Amount is the gain or loss amount for the linked contracts. Gain Loss Amount is applicable to FX Forward Close Contracts. FxOrders__OrderRegulatoryDetails.description: This object holds the regulatory information that is provided by the client. If a client is expected to provide details like date and time at which the order is received from the end client, the commnication channel through which the order was received etc. they can use this object to provide such details to SWP.

dateReceivedFromClient.description: Date on which the order was received from the end client.

timeReceivedFromClient.description: Time at which the order was received from the client, in 24hr format.

orderMethod.description: Commnication channel through which the order was received from the end client.

telephoneExtension.description: Applicable only when the order method is Telephone. This attribute would be used to provide the telephone extension at which the end client placed their order.

delayedInputReason.description: If there has been a delay in placing the end client order, firms can use this field to explain the reason behind that dealy

FxOrders__FxOrderLinkageReference.description: This will be utilized to communicate a common reference for swapping out FX Forward & FX Spot. A spot and a forward order can be linked with each other at the FX aggregator by providing the same reference while creating them, provided they are created as straight through processing(STP) orders. This reference will be sent out to the FX aggregator via FIX Message type ‘D’

FxOrders__CreateFxSpotOrderRequest.description: This object gets the API input from the requestor to create a foreign exchange spot order.

processingOrgId.description: The internal value that uniquely identifies a processing organization within an instance. This attribute is conditional - may not be provided, if firmId is provided in the request.

firmId.description: The internal value that uniquely identifies a firm within an instance. This attribute is conditional may not be provided, if portfolioId is specified in the request.

accountNumber.description: Account Number for which the FX Spot order is being created. Account Number is the externally-known identifier for an account. Conditional - not Required, if portfolioId is provided.

portfolioName.description: Name of the Portfolio in which the FX Spot order needs to be created. Its the basic name that most frequently used for display and reporting purposes. Conditional - not required, if the request specifies the portfolioId.

portfolioId.description: Internal value that uniquely identifies a portfolio, at which the Spot order is being created. Conditional - not required, if both Account Name & Portfolio Name are provided.

fxOrderSide.description: This attribute specifies whether the FX Spot Order is to buy a currency or to sell a currency

buyCurrency.description: ISO Currency Code of the currency which would be bought as a result of the FX Order that is being created.

sellCurrency.description: ISO Currency Code of the currency which would be sold as a result of the FX Order that is being created.

amount.description: Transactional amount which is being ordered as part of this FX Order. If Order Side=Buy, then, Amount field will represent Buy Amount. If Order Side=Sell, then, Amount field will represent Sell Amount.

straightThroughProcessingFlag.description: Flag that indicates how the order has to be sent to the FX Agent. If the the flag is set to 'Yes', then the order will be immediately sent to the FX Agent. If the flag is set to 'No', then the order will pooled with similar orders as per the SWP Order Pooling Process. Default value would be 'No'

accountTypeId.description:
Account type helps determine the processing behavior of the acocunt in the SEI Wealth Platform.  Certain actions on the account may be allowed or disallowed based on the account type.  Addtiional data collection may or may not be required based on the account type.  It is not a direct correlation to an account registration type.  Callers supply a value based on a predefined set of codes.
| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 157 | Investment Account |
| 172 | Stocks and Shares ISA |
| 173 | Stocks and Shares Junior ISA |
| 177 | Traditional IRA |
| 178 | Roth IRA |
| 179 | SEP IRA |
| 180 | Inherited Traditional IRA |
| 181 | Inherited Roth IRA |
| 182 | Employee Benefit Plan (403b) |
| 183 | SIMPLE IRA |

accountSubTypeId.description:
Account sub type further helps define processing behavior of the account in the SEI Wealth Platform.  Callers supply a value based on a predefined set of codes.
| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Investment Account |
| 4 | Self-Employed SEP |
| 5 | Employee SEP |
| 6 | Tax Wrapper |
| 8 | Shadow |

Note - Additional business validations are performed to ensure the Account Sub Type ID is allowed, based on the Account Type ID sent in the request.

Note- part of the firm configuration includes linking an account classification to a universe classification (e.g. Pension, Charity, Trust or Estate).  Additional required fields must be specified based on the mapped universe classification (see below for details).

accountSubClassificationId.description: Identifier of the account sub-classification. In the UK, this is a predefined set of codes. In the US, this is a set of codes that are configured by the firm. Note- part of the firm configuration includes mapping an account sub-classification to an account classification. If the account sub-classification is mapped to the account classification supplied above, this field in conditionally required.

firmInvestmentCapacityId.description:
The firm investment capacity defines the firm’s level of discretion, or it's authority, in managing the investments in the account. It is not the bank capacity from a legal ownership perspective (see firmCapacityId).

The allowed values are -
| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Discretionary | 
| 4 | Advisory |
| 5 | Execution Only |
  

Note - In the US, firms can configure display name aliases that differ from the code descriptions above.  However, the codes above are used in this API.

accountTemplateId.description: Identifier of the template used to open this account.  Account template ID is a firm configured value and must be associated to the specified accountTypeId and accountSubTypeId above.

estateInceptionDate.description: If the accountClassificationId above is configured to be associated with a Universe Classification of 'Estate', this field is conditionally required to be specified as the inception date or legal reporting date of the estate.  Otherwise, the field is ignored.

trustAgreementDate.description: If the accountClassificationId above is configured to be associated with a Universe Classification of 'Trust', this field is conditionally required to be specified as the inception date or legal reporting date of the trust.  Otherwise, the field is ignored.

reinvestmentMethodOfFundsId.description: The default reinvestment method used for dividends from mutual funds. If supplied, this value ovverides the value contained in the accountTemplateId supplied above. If not supplied, the value contained in the accountTemplateId is used.

reinvestmentMethodOfSweepId.description: The default reinvestment method used for dividends from sweep vehicles. If supplied, this value ovverides the value contained in the accountTemplateId supplied above. If not supplied, the value contained in the accountTemplateId is used.

solutionId.description: A firm-configured list of values that describe the solution that is representing the account.

accountName.description: The short name of the account used for display purposes. This field is separate from the account registration name field.

accountQualifierId.description: If configured by the firm, the identifier of the account qualifier used for fees and reporting.

residingOrgId.description: If the account is defined at the firm level, this value is the same as the firmId above.  If the account is defined at the sub-firm level under the firm, this is the ID of the particular sub-firm.

charityId.description: If the accountClassificationId supplied above is configured to be associated with a Universe Classification of "Charity", this value is the legal identifier created by the appropriate regulating body. Callers optionally may supply this value during account open. In general, this universe classification/field combination is in use for UK firms.

pensionId.description: If the accountClassificationId supplied above is configured to be associated with a Universe Classification of "Pension", this value is the identifier created by the appropriate regulating body. Callers optionally may supply this value during account open. In general, this universe classification and field combination is in use for UK firms.

firmCapacityId.description: This is the legal capacity of the firm over the account.  This field is firm-configurable.  If configured by the firm, this is the identifierr of the firm capacity for the account.

typeOfTrustId.description: If the accountTemplateId supplied above contains one of the following tax forms, then this field is required - Form 1041, Form 5227, Form 990, or Form 990PF.

inheritanceDesignationId.description:
Inherited Designation is only required for Inherited Traditional IRA and Inherited Roth IRA account types.  RMD calculations for those Inherited IRAs are dependent on this value. The first 2 values only apply if the Decedent is an Individual.  The latter 2 values apply only if the Decedent is an Organization. For more details, see the SEI Wealth Platform service guide for qualified accounts.
 | Code | Description |
 | --- | --- |
 | 1 | Inherited by spouse |
 | 2 | Inherited by non-spouse |
 | 3 | Inherited by entity - look-through trust | 
 | 4 | Inherited by Entity – Other |

accountNumber.description: The identifying value associated with the account. This value is alphanumeric and must be unique within the firm. Firms may configure the maximum length of the account number to be less than 17 characters.

taxWrapProviderId.description: Conditionally required when the Account SubType is Tax Wrapper (6).

taxWrapExternalAccountNumber.description: Conditionally required when Account SubType is TaxWrapper (6). This is the account number assigned at the tax wrap provider.

accountBaseCurrency.description: The ISO currency code of the currency for which all valuations are based in the account.

grandfathered403BFlg.description: If the Account Type is US Employee Benefit Plan (403b), then this flag must be set regarding whether the values are grandfathered in from previous US tax law or not. For more details, see the SEI Wealth Platform service guide for qualified accounts.

investmentPerformanceFlg.description: If supplied, this value ovverides the value contained in the accountTemplateId supplied above. If not supplied, the value contained in the accountTemplateId is used. If performance returns are to be calculated and maintained for this account, set this to true.

employeeInfoSharingFlg.description: If the Account Type is US Employee Benefit Plan (403b), then this flag must be set regarding whether employee information sharing should be set for this account or not.  Otherwise, a validation error is returned. For more details, see the SEI Wealth Platform service guide for qualified accounts.

InitiateEnrollment__EmployeeServicingRel.description: The list of Employee servicing relationships that should be set on the account.  Any mandatory servicing relationship configured for the firm must be specified within the call in order to open the account.  Multiplicity of 0 to N.

items.description: The idenitification of an employee servicing relationship.

servicingRelationshipId.description: A number corresponding to a specific firm-configured employee servicing relationship type for the account (e.g. Relationship Manager).

employeeEntityId.description: The SEI Wealth Platform partyId of the employee that will be associated with the servicingRelationshipId above.

InitiateEnrollment__TeamServicingRelatio.description: The list of Team servicing relationships that should be set on the account.   Any mandatory servicing relationship configured for the firm must be specified within the call in order to open the account.  Multiplicity of 0 to N.

items.description: The idenitification of a team servicing relationship.

servicingRelationshipId.description: A number corresponding to a specific firm-configured team servicing relationship type for the account (e.g. Adminstration Team).

teamId.description: The SEI Wealth Platform identifier of the team that will be associated with the servicingRelationshipId above.

InitiateEnrollment__AccountOwner.description: When opening an account, there must be at least 1 primary owner specified using either primaryOwnerExternalId or primaryOwnerEntityId.  An array of 0 to 3 joint owners can also be specified, if applicable.

primaryOwnerExternalId.description: Identifier of the primary owner as defined by the Firm. It is the external source system reference number of the party who is the primary owner of the account.  This value must match a value provided in either the clientExternalPartyId or externalPartyId attribute in the clientList array below for one of the clients specified.

primaryOwnerEntityId.description: Identifier of the primary owner as defined by the SEI Wealth Platform (SWP).  It corresponds to the entity ID of a party that already exists in SWP.  This value must match the value provided in either the clientEntityId or thirdPartyEntityId attribute in the clientList array below for one of the clients specified.

jointOwners.description: When opening an account with more than one owner, the additional account owners are specified as joint owners. Multiplicity of 0 to 3.

items.description: The identification of a joint owner.

jointOwnerEntityId.description: Identifier of the joint owner as defined by the SEI Wealth Platform (SWP).  It corresponds to the entity ID of a party that already exists in SWP.  This value must match the value provided in either the clientEntityId or thirdPartyEntityId attribute in the clientList array below for one of the clients specified.

jointOwnerExternalId.description: Identifier of a joint owner as defined by the Firm. It is the external source system reference number of the party who is a joint owner of the account.  This value must match a value provided in either the clientExternalPartyId or externalPartyId attribute in the clientList array below for one of the clients specified.

jointOwnershipTypeId.description: This attribute is required when the Joint Owner node exists. It identifies the type of account ownership shared by all owners of the account.

InitiateEnrollment__Portfolios.description: Portfolios are the locations within the account where positions are held and actual trading occurs. At least 1 principal portfolio must be provided. Up to five principal portfolios and five associated income portfolios can be provided.

portfolioName.description: The short name of the portfolio used for display purposes.

cashSweepModelId.description: The identifier associated with a cash sweep vehicle that may be assigned to the portfolio.

indexPackageId.description: The identifer associated with an index package that may be assigned to the portfolio.

portfolioPurposeId.description:
Firm configured purposes that may be assigned to the portfolio. If the portfolio has a specific purpose/type, it is defined in the system code 36540.
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 1 | Client Directed |
| 2 | Advisor Guided |
| 3 | Asset Transit |
| 4 | Holding Money Market |
| 5 | SEI Strategy |
| 6 | Asset Transit Tax Transition |
| 7 | Managed Account |
| 8 | Unit Cost Averaging |
| 9 | Non Strategy |
| 10 | SEI Funds |

cashSweepModelId.description: The identifier associated with a cash sweep vehicle that may be assigned to the portfolio.

InitiateEnrollment__ThirdPartyDecedent.description: When opening an Inherited Traditional IRA or Inherited Roth IRA, the decedent of that IRA must be specified in this object. Otherwise, this object should not be included. Similar to the ClientList this can be a new party or reference to an existing party. Multiplicity of 0 to N.

InitiateEnrollment__ExistingThirdPartyDe.description: If the decedent of the Inherited IRA is an existing party in the SEI Wealth Platform, this object contains the entityId or externalPartyId of that party.

externalPartyId.description: The external party identifier of an existing party (either client or third party) where that existing party is to be associated to the account as the decedent.  Either externalPartyId or entityId below must be specified within the existingThirdPartyDecedent object.

entityId.description: The SEI Wealth Platform entity identifier of an existing party (either client or third party) where that existing party is to be associated to the account as the decedent.  Either entityID or externalPartyId above must be specified within the existingThirdPartyDecedent object.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the decedent. This attribute is required when the date of birth does not exist in the SEI Wealth Platform for the existing party.

dateDeceased.description: The date of death of the decedent. This attribute is required when the dateDeceased does not exist in the SEI Wealth Platform for the existing party.

InitiateEnrollment__NewThirdPartyDeceden.description: If the decedent of the Inherited IRA is a new party that should be created as part of enrollment, this object contains the attributes for that party.

firstName.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the First Name of the decedent.

lastName.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the Last Name of the decedent.

externalPartyId.description: The external source system reference number as defined by the firm corresponding to the external party ID for the third party.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the decedent.  It must be specified for New Third Party Decedent and cannot be greater than date of death.

dateDeceased.description: The date of death of the decedent. It must be specified for New Third Party Decedent.

identifierISOCountry.description: The ISO country code of the country associated to the tax identifier of the decedent.

politicalSubDivision.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the political subdivision, such as a state, associated to the tax identifier of the decedent.

taxIdTypeId.description:
The integer code representing the type of tax identification number. Possibile values are - 
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 1 | Employer Identification Number |
| 2 | Preparer Taxpayer Identification Number |
| 3 | Social Security Number |
| 4 | Individual Taxpayer Identification Number |
| 5 | Alien Taxpayer Identification Number/ITIN |
| 6 | Tax Reference Number |
| 7 | National Insurance Number |
| 8 | Social Insurance |
| 10 | Personal Number |
| 11 | Tax Number |
| 31 | Other |
| 33 | Applied For |
| 34 | Unknown |
| 35 | Unknown NINO |
| 36 | No Tax ID on File |
| 37 | Pension ID |
| 38 | NRA Foreign Tax Identification Number |
| 39 | MIFID - Passport |

| 45 | Secondary Social Security Number |
