isoCountry.description: The ISO country code of the country associated to the legal address of the decedent.

addressLine1.description: The first address line associated to the legal address of the decedent. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine2.description: The second address line associated to the legal address of the decedent. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

city.description: The name of the city associated to the legal address of the decedent. (US Firm Country allows 20 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 40 Characters).

politicalSubDivision.description: The political sub division associated with the legal address of the decedent. When applicable, this value must be the full name of the state or province (e.g. use Pennsylvania but not PA).

postalCode.description: The Zip code or other postal code associated with the legal address of the decedent.

placeInFront.description: If set to true, the postalCode is displayed before the City.  If set to false, the postal code is displayed after the politicalSubDivision.  Normally for US addresses, this value is false.  Will default to false, if not specified.

InitiateEnrollment__ThirdPartyRegistered.description: When opening a Stocks and Shares Junior ISA (JISA), the Registered Contact of that JISA must be specified in this object.  Otherwise, this object should not be included.  Similar to the ClientList, this can be a new party or a reference to an existing party. Multiplicity of 0 to N.

InitiateEnrollment__ExistingThirdPartyRe.description: If the registered contact of the JISA is an existing party in the SEI Wealth Platform, this object contains the entityId or externalPartyId of that party. Multiplicity of 0 to N.

externalPartyId.description: The external party identifier of an existing party (either client or third party) where that existing party is to be associated to the account as the registered contact.  Either externalPartyId or entityId below must be specified within the existingThirdPartyRegisterdContact object.

entityId.description: The SEI Wealth Platform entity identifier of an existing party (either client or third party) where that existing party is to be associated to the account as the registered contact.  Either entityID or externalPartyId above must be specified within the existingThirdPartyRegisteredContact object.

InitiateEnrollment__NewThirdPartyRegiste.description: If the registered contact of the JISA is a new party that should be created as part of enrollment, this object contains the attributes for that party. Multiplicity of 0 to N.

OrganizationName.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the organization name of the registered contact.

firstName.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the First Name of the registered contact.

lastName.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the Last Name of the registered contact.

externalPartyId.description: The external source system reference number as defined by the firm corresponding to the external party ID of the Third Party.

thirdPartyTypeId.description: The code corresponding to the Client Type of the third party who is being added as the registered contact.  Options are 5 - Individual, 6 - Organization

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the registered contact.  Firms may opt to supply the value if thirdPartyTypeId is 5 (Individual).

identifierISOCountry.description: The ISO country code of the country associated to the tax identifier of the registered contact.

politicalSubDivision.description: An alphanumeric value corresponding to the political subdivision, such as a state, associated to the tax identifier of the registered contact.

addressLine1.description: The first address line associated to the legal address of the registered contact. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine2.description: The second address line associated to the legal address of the registered contact. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine3.description: The third address line associated to the legal address of the registered contact. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine4.description: The fourth address line associated to the legal address of the registered contact.  Only used for non-US addresses within UK Firm Country. (UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine5.description: The fifth address line associated to the legal address of the registered contact.  Only used for non-US addresses within UK Firm Country. (UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

city.description: The name of the city associated to the legal address of the registered contact. (US Firm Country allows 20 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 40 Characters).

politicalSubDivision.description: The political sub division associated to the legal address of the registered contact. When applicable, this value must be the full name of the state or province (e.g. use Pennsylvania but not PA).

postalCode.description: The zip code or other postal code associated to the legal address of the registered contact.

placeInFront.description: If set to true, the postalCode is displayed before the City.  If set to false, the postal code is displayed after the politicalSubDivision.  Normally for US addresses, this value is false.  Will default to false, if not specified.

clientExternalPartyId.description: The external source system reference number of an existing party who is already a client on SEI Wealth Platform.  This value should already be present in the External Party ID field of the existing client.

clientEntityId.description: The SEI Wealth Platform entity identifier of an existing party who is already a client on SEI Wealth Platform.

existingThirdParty.description: This value is set to true when an existing third party needs to be converted to a client.  Otherwise, the value is false.

externalPartyId.description: The external source system reference number of a new client or existing third party. This value must be supplied for a new client. It must be supplied for an existing third party if the thirdPartyEntityId is not supplied.

thirdPartyEntityId.description: TThe SEI Wealth Platform entity identifier of an existing third party.  This value must be supplied if the externalPartyId of the existing third party is not supplied.

residingOrgId.description: If the client is defined at a firm level, this is the same as the firmId above.  If client is defined in a sub-firm under the firm, this is the ID of the particular sub-firm.

clientTypeId.description: The code corresponding to the Client Type of the party.  Options are 5 - Individual, 6 - Organization

clientTemplateId.description: Identifier of the template used to create this client.  Client template ID is a firm configured value and must be associated to the specified clientTypeId above.

legalEntityId.description: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) will be an Mandatory attribute to Organization Type end clients and optional for existing third party.  For clients with client type of Individual (5), it will always be NULL.

individualDetails.description: When creating a new Individual client (clientTypeId is 5 and existingThirdParty is false), this object must be included.

titleId.description: This code corresponds to the title of an individual client, such as Mr., Mrs., Dr., The Honorable, GEN, etc. It is defined in system code 451.

firstName.description:
First name of the individual client.  Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional). 
Note-  Combined First Name, Middle Name, Last Name and Suffix values (including spaces and punctuation) cannot exceed 100 characters

middleName.description:
Middle name of the individual client.
Note-  Combined First Name, Middle Name, Last Name and Suffix values (including spaces and punctuation) cannot exceed 100 characters

lastName.description:
Last name of the individual client. Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional).
Note-  Combined First Name, Middle Name, Last Name and Suffix values (including spaces and punctuation) cannot exceed 100 characters

suffixId.description: This code corresponds to the suffix of an individual client, such as Jr., Sr., II, Esq, MD, DDS, etc. It is defined in system code 5044.

formalSalutation.description: The formal salutation of an individual client that is used in communications to the client.

genderId.description: No longer shown in SEI Wealth Platform.

maritalStatusId.description:
If desired, the marital status of the individual. This is not required to open the account.
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 1 | Married |
| 2 | Never Married |
| 3 | Separated |
| 7 | Partnered |
| 8 | Divorced |
| 9 | Widower |
| 10 | Widowed |

mailingLabelName.description: The mailing label name of an individual client that is used in the first line of the mailing address on communications to the client.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the individual client. Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional).

countryOfBirth.description: The 2-character country code based on the ISO 3166 standard. This code uniquely identifies the country where the individual client was born.

countryOfCitizenshipFirstPassport.description: The ISO country code of the country where the individual client has citizenship.

clientRiskRatingId.description: The firm-configured code associated to the measure of acceptable risk (also known as risk tolerance or attitude toward risk) for a specific client. This field is optionally used and may not be applicate for a particular firm.

isClientSubjectToFATCAWithholding.description: This column identifies whether the client is subject to Chapter 4 withholding in the United States under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), or not.

clientAMLRiskRating.description:
The code corresponding to anti-money laundering (AML) risk of the client. Allowable options are - 
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| 1 | Low |
| 2 | Medium |
| 3 | High |
Note - Additional business validations are performed to ensure the Client AML Risk field is set to Yes, if a Medium or High Client AML Risk Rating is passed in the request. Otherwise, the Client AML Risk Field is set to No.

clientAMLRiskLastReviewDate.description: The most recent review date of the anti-money laundering (AML) risk of the client. Future dates are not allowed.

clientPEP.description: The code corresponding to the political exposure of the client. Allowable values are 1 - Yes and 2 - No.

clientPEPLastReviewDate.description: The most recent review date of the politcal exposure of the client. Future dates are not allowed.

address.description: Conditionally mandatory. The legal address for the client. The object is required for a new client, but when converting a third party, it will only be required if the third party does not already have a legal address in the SEI Wealth Platform.  Further, for third parties, if the address is specified but the third party already has a legal address in the SEI Wealth Platform, the values provided in this API will be ignored.

isoCountry.description: The ISO country code asociated to the legal address of the client. Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional).

addressLine1.description: The first address line associated to the legal address of the client. Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional). addressLine2.description: The second address line associated to the legal address of the client. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine3.description: The third address line associated to the legal address of the client. (US Firm Country allows 36 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 52 Characters).

addressLine4.description: The fourth address line associated to the legal address of the client. Only used for non-US addresses in firms with UK Firm Country.

addressLine5.description: The fifth address line associated to the legal address of the client.  Only used for non-US addresses in firms with UK Firm Country.

city.description: The city associated to the legal address of the client.  Conditionally mandatory (For new client, it is mandatory but when converting an existing third party to a client, it is optional). (US Firm Country allows 20 Characters and UK Firm Country allows 40 Characters).

placeInFront.description: If set to true, the postalCode is displayed before the City.  If set to false, the postal code is displayed after the politicalSubDivision.  For US addresses, this value is false.  Will default to false, if not specified.

phoneMethodId.description:
The code corresponding to the classification of the phone number.  Allowable options are -

| 1 | Telephone |
| 2 | Mobile |
| 3 | Fax |
| 4 | Pager |

areaCode.description: The area code of the U.S. phone number.  For example, in +1-610-676-0000, the Area Code is 610.

localPhoneNumber.description:
The phone number of the client.  For international phone numbers, do not include the country code.  The country code is defaulted to the country associated to the legal address of the client.  Additionally, this phone is defaulted to the primary phone number.

Note- If this object is specified, the phoneMethodId becomes required.

emailAddress.description:
The email address of the client.

 Note-  If this object is specified, the emailAddress becomes required.  This email is defaulted to the primary email address.

taxInformation.description: Conditionally mandatory.  The tax identification information for the client. politicalSubDivision.description: When appplicable, this must be the full name of the state or province (e.g. use Pennsylvania but not PA). This value is required based on the country specified. For example, it is required for addresses within the United States.

eventId.description: This field indicates the event Id associated with the cash receipt which needs to be modified.

cancelEvent.description: This field indicates the cancel event flag as true or false. If provided true, then the service will cancel the existing cash receipt. This can only be done for event based cash receipts and not adhoc cash receipts.  The state and status must be eligible as well with the status of scheduled, exception, in-progress - waiting for matching, or in-progress - pending approval.

externalRef.description: This field indicates the external reference number value if needs to be modified for existing cash receipt.

investCash.description: This field indicates the invest cash value if needs to be modified for existing cash receipt.

eligibleForICScheduler.description: This field indicates the eligible for IC scheduler value if needs to be modified for existing cash receipt.

notes.description: This field indicates the notes value if needs to be modified for existing cash receipt.

effectiveDate.description: This field indicates the effective date which needs to be updated [MM/DD/YYYY].

bypassApprovals.description: This field indicates the bypass approval flag true or false if provided true then approval process will be by passed.

portfolioId.description: This field indicates the portfolio Id associated with cash activity that needs to be modified

amountIncludesFees.description: This field indiactes amount include net fee or not

beneficiaryInstBIC.description: The beneficiaryInstBIC is optional field for modifying payto detail service. indirectPaymentIndicatorFlg.description: The indirectPaymentIndicatorFlg is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type SWIFT only. its equivalent to "Indirect Payment [SWIFT]" in UI. The value should be like true or false

intermediaryBankIdentifier.description: The intermediaryBankIdentifier is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type SWIFT only. its equivalent to “Intermediary Bank Identifier:[SWIFT]” in UI. If indirectPaymentIndicatorFlg value pass as True in request then intermediaryBankIdentifier and intermediaryAccountNumber  field will be mandatory.

intermediaryAccountNumber.description: The intermediaryAccountNumber is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type SWIFT only. its equivalent to “Intermediary Bank Account Number:[SWIFT]” in UI. If indirectPaymentIndicatorFlg value pass as True in request then intermediaryBankIdentifier and intermediaryAccountNumber  field will be mandatory.

accountName.description: The accountName is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type BACS only. its equivalent to “Account Name:[ BACS]” in UI.

beneficiaryReferenceOrRollNumber.description: The beneficiaryReferenceOrRollNumber is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type BACS only. its equivalent to “Beneficiary Reference / Roll Number:[ BACS]” in UI.

notesToClient.description: The notesToClient is optional field for modifying payto detail service. Its applicable in disburse type Check only. its equivalent to “Notes to Client: ( US Firm), Additional Information: ( UK Firm)” in UI.

Conditional Mandatory- It is mandatory when defaultRecurrenceFrequency is provided with valid values 2 or 3 or 4 or 5. endAfterAdditionalOccurrences.description: This field specifies number of additional occurances after which given event can be stopped.Expected values are between 0 to 16. Null value is not accepted

endAfterScheduleDateOfDate.description: This field specifies a end date after scheduled date after which given event can be stopped.Accepts date with pattern 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Null value is not accepted

acctPeriodEndMonth.description: This field specifies account period end month for given event. It accepts numerical representation(1-12) for a month

locationContext.description: The respective ID of the Location Context, either sub-firm, firm or PO, for which the fee rule is being created or modified. Must be an active sub-firm, firm or PO ID on the platform.

feeRuleId.description: Periodic fee rule ID that is to be modified. Must be an active, periodic fee rule ID on the platform belonging to the location context hierarchy specified. Additionally, the fee rule cannot have a pending Periodic Fee Rule Maintenance approval activity.

feeType.description: The Fee Type ID for the fee rule being created or modified. Must be a periodic fee type ID on the platform belonging to the location context hierarchy specified. Once a rule is created, the fee type cannot be modified.

ruleDescription.description: The rule description for the fee rule being created or modified. Only the following special characters are allowed: (. , @ space - / ' & _ )

feeBasis.description: The Fee Basis ID for the fee rule being created or modified. Once a rule is created, the fee basis cannot be modified. Must be one of the following values: 1 (Average Daily Market Value), 2 (Market Value as of), 3 (Transaction Count), 6 (Position Count), 7 (Flat Charge), 8 (Account Specific Fees), 9 (Transaction Amount), 10 (Service Based Fee)

portfolio.description: The indicator to determine which kinds of portfolios to include in the fee basis for this rule, either 1 (Capital and Income portfolios), 2 (Capital) or 3 (Income), based on the system code ID 33286. This field is not allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Account Specific Fees, but is required for all other fee basis values.

includeCash.description: The indicator to determine whether or not to include cash in the fee basis for this rule, either 1 (Yes) or 2 (No). This field is not allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Account Specific Fees, Transaction Amount, Transaction Count or Service Based Fee, but is required for all other fee basis values.

includeAccruedInterest.description: The indicator to determine whether or not to include accrued interest in the fee basis for this rule, either 1 (Yes) or 2 (No). This field is not allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Account Specific Fees, Transaction Amount, Transaction Count or Service Based Fee, but is required for all other fee basis values.

currency.description: The ISO code of the Currency of the fee rule being created or modified. Once a rule is created, the currency cannot be modified.

serviceType.description: The Service Type ID for which the Service Based Fee applies. Must be an active and configured service type ID on the platform belonging to the location context hierarchy specified. Valid values are determined based on the combination of the system code ID 37255 and records in the fee_service_basis_config table for the specified location context. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Service Based Fee.

cashFeeBasis.description: The indicator to determine whether Net Amount or Gross Amount is used to determine how the cash is handled in the fee basis amount for the fee basis for this rule. Valid values are either 1 (Net Amount) or 2 (Gross Amount), based on the system code ID 37588. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Transaction Amount and when Transaction Types selected are both Cash Receipt and Cash Disbursement.

rateType.description: The Rate Type ID for the fee rule being created or modified. This field is not allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Account Specific Fees, but is required for all other fee basis values. This field value must be 1 (Flat Amount) when fee basis is Flat Charge. This field value must be either 1 (Flat Amount), 6 (Banded Amount) or 8 (Tiered Amount) when fee basis is either Transaction Count, Position Count or Service Based Fee. This field value can be any value except 1 (Flat Amount) when fee basis is Transaction Amount. When modifying a fee rule that is using dual qualifiers, this field cannot be changed. Must be one of the following values (system code ID 33280): 1 (Flat Amount), 5 (Flat Percentage), 6 (Banded Amount), 7 (Banded Percentage), 8 (Tiered Amount), 9 (Tiered Percentage)

vatApplicable.description: The Fee Rule ID corresponding to the VAT rule to apply as part of this fee rule. To value this field, the firm must be configured for VAT functionality. If this field is valued as 0 when creating a fee rule, VAT will not be applied to the rule. If this field is valued as 0 when modifiying a fee rule, the corresponding VAT will be removed from the rule. Current valid values (additional values could be added in the future): 1 (UK 0%), 2 (UK 15%), 3 (UK 17.5%), 100 (UK 20%)

ruleMinimumAmount.description: The Rule Minimum Amount to be charged for the fee rule being created or modified. Values can have up to ten digits total, with up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a rate type of Flat Percentage, Banded Percentage or Tiered Percentage. The Rule Minimum Amount must be less than the Rule Maximum Amount.

ruleMaximumAmount.description: The Rule Maximum Amount to be charged for the fee rule being created or modified. Values can have up to ten digits total, with up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a rate type of Flat Percentage, Banded Percentage or Tiered Percentage. The Rule Maximum Amount must be greater than the Rule Minimum Amount.

PeriodicFeeRuleCreationandModification__.description: The Transaction Type(s) ID(s) to consider in the fee basis for this rule. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Transaction Amount or Transaction Count. Only a single value can be provided for fee rules with a fee basis of Transaction Count and one or more unique values can be provided for fee rules with a fee basis of Transaction Amount. Once a rule is created, the transaction type(s) cannot be modified. Valid values for a fee basis of Transaction Count are:  1 (Buy), 2 (Sell), 3 (Free Delivery), 4 (Free Receipt), 6 (Cash Receipt), 7 (Cash Disbursement), 9 (Currency Interest Posting), 23 (Reinvestment), 25 (Dutch Auction), 26 (Exchance Offer), 27 (Final Maturity), 28 (Full Call), 29 (Installment Call), 31 (Liquidation), 39 (Partial Call), 42 (Put Redemption), 71 (Principal Payment). Valid values for a fee basis of Transaction Amount are: 1 (Buy), 2 (Sell), 3 (Free Delivery), 4 (Free Receipt), 6 (Cash Receipt), 7 (Cash Disbursement), 19 (Cash Dividend), 23 (Reinvestment).

This list includes various fields for the fee rule’s rate details. This list is not allowed to be valued for fee rules with a fee basis of Account Specific Fees, but is required for all other fee basis values. Only one list can be provided when the rate type is Flat Amount or Flat Percentage. Between one to ten lists can be provided when the rate type is Banded Amount or Banded Percentage. At least two lists, but not more than ten, must be provided when the rate type is Tiered Amount or Tiered Percentage. The list contains the following five fields: feeRuleSequenceId, low, high, valuation, bandMinimumAmount

feeRuleSequenceId.description: The sequence number for the rate bands. This field is required for all lists. The values must start from 1 and be in sequential order across the lists, up to a maximum value of 10.

low.description: The low threshold value for the respective rate band or tier. Values can have up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999999.99. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is not allowed to be valued when the rate type is Flat Amount or Flat Percentage, but is required for all lists for all other rate types. This value must be 0 when Fee Rule Sequence ID is 1 for all fee basis values besides Transaction Count. Within each list, the Low value must be less than the corresponding High value. Between lists, the High value in a given Fee Rule Sequence ID must equal the Low value in the next Fee Rule Sequence ID.

high.description: The high threshold value for the respective rate band or tier. Values can have up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999999.99. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is not allowed to be valued when the rate type is Flat Amount or Flat Percentage, but is required for all lists, except the highest Fee Rule Sequence ID, for all other rate types; this value must be left blank for the highest Fee Rule Sequence ID. Within each list, the High value must be greater than the corresponding Low value. Between lists, the High value in a given Fee Rule Sequence ID must equal the Low value in the next Fee Rule Sequence ID.

valuation.description: The fee rate or amount to be applied to the respective band or tier. Values can have up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999999.99 for Flat Amount, Banded Amount or Tiered Amount rate types and the range of allowable values is 0.000001 to 100.00 for Flat Percentage, Banded Percentage or Tiered Percentage rate types. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is required for all lists.

bandMinimumAmount.description: The Band Minimum Amount to be charged for the respective band. Values can have up to two digits following the decimal point, and the range of allowable values is 0.01 to 9999999999999.99. This field cannot contain any special characters, besides the decimal point. This field is only allowed to be valued for fee rules with a rate type of Banded Percentage.

partyId.description:
The internal identifier representing an End client or Third Party. A Party Identifier is required. If partyId field value is specified to be an end client then associated accounts owned, joint accounts owned and IPRO accounts historic market values are retrieved
If the Third Party is specified then this party must have IPOR relationship with accounts and historic market values are retrieved.

accountNumberList.description:
The account number list field is a mandatory input. Only market values related to the provided accounts will be returned. The specified accounts must be an account which the input party (end client/third Party) owns or joint owns or have IPOR relationship.
1 - All closed/InActive accounts are allowed.
2 - Duplicate account numbers are not allowed.
3 - Accepts max of 15 account numbers.
4 - Account number list field cannot be empty.

periodType.description:
The period type for which market values should be returned. Valid inputs are:
1 – Daily
2 - Weekly
3 - Monthly
4 - Quarterly
For all these frequencies Data is retrieved for maximum for last 30 occurrences or till the snapshot (data) is available, whichever is lesser. However, for the better performance/quick response of the API it is recommended that user doesn't provide more than 12 for weekly, monthly and quarterly. If no value is specified, 1 (Daily) is defaulted.

periodFrequency.description: The number of periods that should be returned related to periodType and startDate. For example, if periodType 1 is specified with no start date and period frequency was 10, the API would return values for the last 10 days from the current date. The maximum value that can be specified is 30. If no value is specified, 1 is defaulted.

startDate.description: The latest date for which to begin returning values. For example, if periodType 1 (daily) and periodFrequency 3 were specified and the start date is 2023-09-04, the API would return values for 2023-09-04, 2023-09-03 and 2023-09-02. If no date is specified, the current system date will be used. The acceptable date format is yyyy-MM-dd

cashTreatmentMethod.description: This property holds the cash treatment method. Cash Treatment Method applicable to Raise Cash instruction- Do   Not Use Cash, Exhaust Cash First, Treat Cash Like Securities

feeOverride.description: Fee over ride is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Manual Order. This property indicates whether real time fee associated to the account can be overridden for order generation. If false, fees are applicable. If True, API will check if initiating user has access to Function point 6046 If user has the function point, fees will be overridden. Default is set to false

includeNDTF.description: Include NDTF is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Automated transaction. This property is applicable for automated transaction request. Indicates whether Non Daily Traded Funds (NDTF) are included in order generation or not. Default is set to true

includeTradeMinRules.description: Include Trade Min Rules is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Automated transactionThis property indicates whether Trade minimum Rules should be applied to automated transaction request. Default is set to true

innerRail.description: Inner rail is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Automated transactionThis property holds the Inner rail that should be applied for automated transaction. If no value is specified, firm configured value will be applied. Default is set to zero

investmentGroupName.description: Investment Group Name is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for an Investment Group. This property holds investment group name on which transaction is being performed. This field is not mandatory if the request is for a Portfolio

portfolioName.description: Portfolio name is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for an account. This property holds the portfolio name on which transaction is being performed. This field is not mandatory if the request is for an account group. Portfolio long name need to use.

requestId.description: This property holds the previous request id

skipICRule.description: This property indicates whether Investment Compliance Rules validation should be skipped for order generation. If false, IC rules will be validated. If True, API will check if initiating user has access to Function point 6507. If user has the function point, all IC rules associated the Portfolio will be skipped. Default is set to false. This is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Manual Order.

skipOverdraft.description: This property indicates whether Overdraft validation should be skipped for order generation. If false, Overdraft is applicable. If True, API will check if initiating user has access to Function point 6597. If user has the function point, overdraft validation will be skipped. Default is set to false. This is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Manual Order.

tokenId.description: This property holds the token id. User can specify an active token id under which the request should be created. If no token Id is specified, a new token id will be created and the request will be created under that token.

toleranceMultiplier.description: This property holds tolerance multiplier. Tolerance multipler should be applied to generate orders while processing automated instruction. If no value is specified, firm level configured value will be used.

transactionAmount.description: This property holds the transaction amount for Invest Cash and Raise cash transactions. This property is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Automated transaction of Raise cash or Invest cash.

transactionMethod.description: This property holds the transaction method. Transaction Methods applicable to Invest Cash - Underweight, Pro rata, Model Weights. Raise Cash - Overweight, Pro rata, Largest Holding first. This property is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Automated transaction of Raise cash or Invest cash.

platformUser.description: This property holds the property platform user. This is an optional field. If platform user is sent in request, API will check if user has access to function point 6883. This is passed only from external api and entitlements should be validated for this user.

Supports Derivative Identifier and Derivative Trading ID for derivative transaction which includes support for ISIN and CUSIP. This is conditional mandadatory input required if the request is for a Manual Order.

assetPriceCurency.description: This property holds the asset price currency
